name: hca-molecular
description: Carbonic anhydrase, 2,482 atoms, on the shared surface — and the case that says where the approximate tier's default is wrong. It is a polar-hydrogen structure, so its heavy-atom radii carry the volume of hydrogens that are not in the file; Generalized Born substitutes an all-atom set and over-solvates by 21%, against 2-4% on every all-atom protein here. Measured, not assumed: the file's own radii give 7.3% on this structure and 26-33% on the all-atom ones.
